# Select

Select — pick one value, or several, from a list, on `_Field` with the internal `Listbox` under it. - **The field is the combobox.** Focus stays in it, and the highlighted row is its `aria-activedescendant`. The field is a text input: typing in it filters the list. With `isSearchable={false}` it is a select-only combobox. - **Values are ids; options are objects.** `value` is an option's `value` (an array with `isMulti`), controlled or not. - **`isMulti`** shows Tags in a TagGroup (`displayMode="tags"`), which collapse into "+n" without focus. - **Trailing** holds the clear × (not a tab stop; Delete does the same) and the caret.

Also asked as: combobox, picklist, option list.

**Import:** `import { Select } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Select/Select.jsx`

## Usage

Use `Select` for a list of six or more options, where typing to filter
helps more than scanning — a tutor roster, a list of schools. Up to five
options belong in view as a `RadioGroup` (one pick) or a Checkbox group
(several). Pick the control by the shape of the answer.

| The choice is | Reach for |
| --- | --- |
| One pick, up to 5 options | `RadioGroup` |
| Several picks, up to 5 options | A Checkbox group (`Fieldset` with `Checkbox`) |
| 6 or more options | `Select`, searchable by default |
| A list held on a server, too large to ship | `Select` with `loadOptions` |
| Options in a hierarchy | `Cascader` or `TreeSelect` |
| Narrowing a table or list from a bar | The tiers of the Filtering pattern |
| An action run from a button | `DropdownMenu` |

### Turn typing off for a short filter list.

Typing is on because most lists are long enough to need it. A filter menu that
holds one short list, applied as you pick, has nothing to search: pass
`isSearchable={false}` so the field stays a plain trigger and Space opens it.

## Best practices

### Keep option labels short and parallel. {#keep-option-labels-short-and-parallel}

Short, parallel labels scan as a list; a sentence in the field gets cut off.

Do: A short label names the value.
Don't: A sentence in the field does not fit.

### Use multi select when answers combine. {#use-multi-select-when-answers-combine}

Several answers belong in Tags, one per answer, not in one comma-joined value.

Do: One Tag per chosen answer.
Don't: Answers joined into one value.

### Show an error on the field itself. {#show-an-error-on-the-field-itself}

Mark the field with `isInvalid` so the message reads as an error; the same words as help text in a default field look fine.

Do: The field shows the error state.
Don't: The same words as plain help, in a default field.

### Pick the mode by the answer. {#pick-the-mode-by-the-answer}

`isMulti` shows picks as Tags and checkboxes in the list; `selectAll` and `maxSelections` apply to it only. Typing filters the list unless you pass `isSearchable={false}`, and `isCreatable` adds a "Create" row when nothing matches. `createOption` turns the typed text into the option it creates, or refuses it with null; Time picker uses it to read "1430" as 2:30 PM. `clearable` defaults to on with `isMulti` and off for a required single select.

### Show picks as text when Tags crowd the field. {#show-picks-as-text-when-tags-crowd-the-field}

`displayMode="text"` (with `isMulti`) shows picks as comma-separated text instead of Tags. `isValid` with `successMessage` draws the success edge and message.

### Chain `dependsOn` for fields that filter each other. {#chain-dependson-for-fields-that-filter-each-other}

Pass the parent's `{ value, label }` as `dependsOn` on the child. The child
disables itself and explains why until the parent has a value, and clears
itself the moment the parent's value changes — no manual wiring needed beyond
passing the parent's current state down.

```jsx
<Select label="School" options={schools} value={school} onChange={setSchool} />
<Select
    label="Teacher"
    options={teachersFor(school)}
    value={teacher}
    onChange={setTeacher}
    dependsOn={{ value: school, label: 'a school' }}
/>
```

### Use `commitOnClose` for a filter bar, not a form field. {#use-commitonclose-for-a-filter-bar-not-a-form-field}

A form's multi-select should fire `onChange` on every pick, so other UI can
react immediately. `commitOnClose` is for the opposite case — a filter panel
where firing once, on close, avoids re-querying on every checkbox click.

### Reach for `loadOptions` once a list is genuinely large or server-backed. {#reach-for-loadoptions-once-a-list-is-genuinely-large-or-server-backed}

`recent` and `suggested` only change the order past 50 static options;
`loadOptions` is for a list too large to ship as a static array at all.

## Accessibility

- **A real combobox.** The field is `role="combobox"` with
  `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`/`aria-activedescendant` tracking the open
  list and its highlighted row.
- **The label is linked, or named explicitly.** Pass `label` for a visible
  one, or `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` when there isn't a visible label.
- **Keyboard parity with a native select.** Arrow keys, Enter and Escape
  open, move through and close the list; Backspace removes the last Tag in a
  multi-select with an empty filter; Delete clears the field when
  `clearable`.
- **A waiting dependent field says why.** `dependsOn`'s disabled state pairs
  with a caption ("Choose a school first"), not silence.

## Related

- For a handful of options visible all at once, use `RadioGroup`.
- For hierarchical options, use `TreeSelect` or `Cascader`.
- For free-form tags rather than a fixed option list, use `TagInput`.

## Parts

1. **Field.** The box that shows the value, or the placeholder, and a chevron.
2. **Label.** Names the field. A required marker follows it.
3. **List.** The options, in a popup under the field. Groups carry a heading.
4. **Caption.** Helper text, or the error that replaces it.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The input fill with a `--border-default` input edge; the placeholder until a value is picked. |
| Hovered | The edge turns `--ds-border-focused`. |
| Pressed | No step of its own. The hovered edge holds while the pointer is down, and the press opens the list. |
| Focused | A `--focus-ring-width` ring in `--ds-border-focused`, `--focus-ring-width` off the box. No fill changes. |
| Disabled | The whole field fades to `--ds-opacity-disabled` and leaves the tab order. |
| Invalid | The edge takes `--ds-border-danger` and the message `--ds-text-danger`. |
| Valid | With `isValid`, the edge takes `--ds-border-success` and `successMessage` shows under the field. |
| Read-only | The `--ds-background-neutral` fill. The value can be read, selected and copied. |

| Search hint | "Type to search" above a long list: `--body-small` in `--ds-text-subtle`, `--space-025` `--pad-x-md`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write each option as the thing itself: "Algebra I". | A sentence or an instruction: "Choose this for algebra". |
| Order options by how often they are picked, or alphabetically for a long list. | A random order that makes people scan. |
| Use a placeholder that names the action: "Select a school". | The label repeated as the placeholder. |
| Say what to do in an error: "Select a school". | "Required" or "Invalid". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | The `id` of the combobox control; the label and the list ids are built from it. Generated when omitted. |
| `name` | string | — | Submitted with a form through hidden inputs, one per value. |
| `label` | node | — | The visible label above the field. Without one, pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. |
| `caption` | node | — | Help under the field. With `isInvalid`, `errorMessage` takes its place and is announced. |
| `isMulti` | bool | `false` | Several values, shown as Tags in the field and checkboxes in the list. |
| `options` | arrayOf (required) | `[]` | Objects: `value` is the id, `label` (or `text`) what is shown. `group` puts consecutive options under a heading. |
| `value` | arrayOf | — | The picked id, or ids with `isMulti`. Pass it to control the field. |
| `defaultValue` | arrayOf | — | The picked id, or ids with `isMulti`, to start with when the field is uncontrolled. |
| `placeholder` | string | `'Select...'` | The text shown when nothing is picked. It names the field when there is no label. |
| `isSearchable` | bool | `true` | Typing in the field filters the list. On by default; pass `false` for a short list, such as a filter menu's. |
| `isCreatable` | bool | `false` | Offers "Create text " when nothing matches exactly, ignoring case. Implies typing. |
| `onCreate` | func | — | Called with the text of a created option, which is then picked. |
| `createOption` | func | — | `(text)` → the option a typed text creates, `{ value, label }`, or null to create nothing. Defaults to the text itself. |
| `open` | bool | — | Holds the list open or shut. Controlled: Escape, a press outside and a pick ask through `onOpenChange`, and the list stays as it is until the parent changes `open`. |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | Whether the list starts open, when `open` is not controlling it. |
| `onOpenChange` | func | — | `(open)`: the list asks to open or close. |
| `defaultSearchTerm` | string | `''` | The text the search input starts with, so the list opens already filtered. Used by a searchable field. |
| `displayMode` | enum | `'tags'` | With `isMulti`: `tags` (Tag chips) or `text` (comma-separated). |
| `lineWrap` | bool | `true` | `text` display mode only: wrap onto more lines. |
| `truncate` | bool | `false` | `text` display mode only: clip the row with a fade. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` draws 40 and `compact` draws 32. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Dims the field and blocks opening and changing it. |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Shows the value, stays focusable, and cannot be changed. |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Shows an asterisk on the label and sets `aria-required`. |
| `info` | node | — | Text for the info tooltip beside the label. |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Draws the error border, sets `aria-invalid`, and `errorMessage` becomes the announced caption. |
| `errorMessage` | node | — | The caption shown under the field while `isInvalid` is set. It is announced. |
| `isValid` | bool | `false` | Draws the confirmation border; `successMessage` takes the caption's place. |
| `successMessage` | node | — | The caption shown under the field while `isValid` is set. |
| `commitOnClose` | bool | `false` | With `isMulti`: `onChange` fires once when the list closes, as a filter bar wants, not on each pick. |
| `clearable` | bool | — | Shows the clear × (Figma `_Field Clear`), and lets Delete empty the field. Defaults to true with `isMulti` and to `!isRequired` otherwise; a sort passes `false`. |
| `selectAll` | bool | `false` | With `isMulti`: a "Select all" button over the list, hidden past 50 matches. |
| `maxSelections` | number | — | With `isMulti`: the most values; past it the other rows are disabled and the list says why. |
| `dependsOn` | shape | — | The field this one depends on: `{ value, label }`. Until `value` is set the field is disabled with "Choose {label} first"; when it changes, this field clears. |
| `isLoading` | bool | `false` | The options are on their way: the list shows a loading row. |
| `loadOptions` | func | — | `(text, { offset, limit })` → `Promise<{ options, total }>`. Options load as the list opens, as you type and as you scroll, 50 at a time. |
| `recent` | arrayOf | — | Ids shown under "Recent" before typing, in a list of more than 50. |
| `suggested` | arrayOf | — | Ids shown under "Suggested" before typing, in a list of more than 50. |
| `onChange` | func | — | `(next)`: an id, or an array of ids with `isMulti`. |
| `onFocus` | func | — | Focus entering the field from outside it. |
| `onBlur` | func | — | Focus leaving the field and its list. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the field wrapper beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the field wrapper. |

## Variants

**`displayMode`** — `tags` · `text`

**`spacing`** — `default` · `compact`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
